task_description: Build MINES STACKER BOT: a premium, futuristic, mobile-only, self-contained HTML/CSS/JS analysis/visualisation app (NOT a playable game). Flow: Seed -> Select Mines -> Analyze -> animated evaluation -> auto-generated fully-revealed 5x5 grid (25 cells) showing 4-5 random safe green gem tiles and the rest as gray mines gradient (never revealing true bomb positions). Uses the official gorilla logo via assets/logo.png (placeholder provided; must be replaced without modification). Deterministic seeded generation. No frameworks, no build step, no external network deps.

verification.summary: No build system or automated test framework (static HTML app), so applicable checks were run instead. `node --check assets/app.js` passes (no syntax errors). External-URL scan of index.html/style.css/app.js is clean; the only http match is the required xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" namespace in the placeholder logo.svg (not a network request). CSS confirms grid-template-columns: repeat(5,...) and a Node replication of the exact PRNG+grid model confirms exactly 25 cells, 4-5 gems, determinism for same seed+mines, different grids for different seed or mines, and only gem/gray states (true bomb positions never revealed). Cells have zero click/reveal handlers, so the app is not playable per spec. Docker build skipped (no Dockerfile; static HTML app runs from file://).
